about.heading: Built on honest work
about.body: We're a Bridgeport handyman team that shows up when we say we will. Real people answering the phone — not a call center.

reviews.name: LIina S.
reviews.text: Lima came out promptly for an estimate. He was reasonable and honest — the best quality in a worker. Amazing job removing old bathroom tiles and rotted subfloor, then installing new tiles.

reviews.name: Tony C.
reviews.text: Lima did an amazing job remodeling my mother's apartment. Professional, on time, and quality work that exceeded expectations. Great communication throughout the whole project.

reviews.name: Louis H.
reviews.text: Fair, honest, prompt, and professional with a great sense of humor. Got the job done in record time. A+++ will definitely use Lima again!

cta.heading: Ready to get it fixed?
cta.body: Call for a free estimate. We'll tell you exactly what it'll take and what it'll cost — no surprises.
